summary.headline: Valens’s Sources and Chronology
summary.text: Editorial discussion of Valens’s star descriptions, including his mixture of Greek and barbaric-sphere doctrines and Egyptian divine names. It examines lunar-cycle chronology, Roman imperial lists, the disputed date and identity of Valens of Antioch, his sources, and his zodiacal chorography.
